registration_scope: local prospective analysis protocol, not a public preregistration
primary_claim: Source-aware predictors can add conditional value within domains, but zero-label China-to-Australia transfer is outside the empirical area of applicability.

primary_monthly_task.estimator: LightGBM regression with parameters fixed from the pre-2021 validation workflow

australia_2025_external_task.target: NSW, Queensland and Victoria regulatory weekly PM2.5
australia_2025_external_task.primary_information_set: structural station/FUA attributes, calendar, weekly aviation weather, MODIS fire and ERA5 boundary-layer height; no current or lagged regulatory target and no 2025 SatPM
australia_2025_external_task.secondary_information_set: same predictors with a one-week regulatory target lag, evaluated and labelled as conditional updating
australia_2025_external_task.note: Queensland and Victoria source files were retrieved before this protocol file was written, but no 2025 PM2.5 values were parsed and no 2025 metric was computed before locking this protocol.

interpretation_boundaries: SatPM is a modelled exposure surface rather than regulatory ground truth.
Current-period meteorology defines retrospective reconstruction or nowcasting, not ex-ante forecasting.
Feature attribution is predictive and not causal.
MODIS active-fire detections are hotspots, not unique fire events or burned area.
AOD is excluded from the primary SatPM predictor set to reduce target circularity.
All 2000-2014 Australian weekly values remain labelled model hindcasts rather than observations.
